summary: Computes lateral tire grip force with a friction-circle model. Builds squared-slip and friction terms from a2/a3/a4/a5 and fields +0x3A70/+0x3514, selects a 14-entry force table (positive base +0x3C40 or negative base +0x3C80, scaled by +0x3C3C/+0x3C7C) via an FP-flag branch, interpolates, then iterates wheel contact patches (count +0x39F8, array base +0x39D0, wheel base this+0x3580 or this+0x3770 selected by the +0x39B4 guard) with an 8-byte-entry interpolation table (+0x39A4) to accumulate a contact capacity v40, looks up an aerodynamic table (+0x3CC0 scaled by +0x3CBC), and returns the force minus the +0x3D44 x +0x3518 slip term and a4[2]. Uses sub_5895A2 as the float-to-table-index conversion helper. Called from PhysicsNodePropagationWithDistanceFalloff (00401C90).

local_names.a3: lateral slip input combined with a4[1]
local_names.a4: slip/force vector; a4[0] and a4[2] used, a4[1] in the friction term
local_names.a5: input combined with a4[0] inside the absolute friction term
local_names.v38: force difference term feeding the force tables
local_names.v48: v35*v35 - v42*v42, gate for the contact iteration
local_names.v40: accumulated contact patch capacity (final cap on v17)
local_names.v21: selected wheel-contact struct base (this+0x3580 or this+0x3770)
local_names.v20: walking pointer over per-patch parameters (base this+0x39D0)

operations.description: Base terms: v5 = a2*a2; v37 = v5; v38 = v5 * this+0x3A70 - (v37*a3 + a4[1]) * this+0x3514; v42 = fabs(v37*a5 - a4[0]) * this+0x3514

FP condition-flag branch (v9|v10 from an elided comparison) selects the positive force table (scale this+0x3C3C, entries at this+0x3C40) versus the negative force table (scale this+0x3C7C, entries at this+0x3C80)

sub_5895A2 converts the scaled force (v11/v15) to a table index; the truncated index is clamped to [0,13] and the force is lerped between adjacent 14-entry table rows (base this+0x3C40 or this+0x3C80)
v35 = (v14 - v13)*(v34 - index) + v13 is the lerped table force; then v48 = v35*v35 - v42*v42; the contact-patch iteration runs only when v48 > 0.0

Contact-patch iteration: v19 runs from 1 to the count at this+0x39F8 while a walking pointer v20 advances from the array base this+0x39D0; per patch the wheel-contact base v21 is this+0x3580 when this+0x39B4 == 2 (packet guard) else this+0x3770, v22 = a2/(v21+144)*v20[0], and the loop breaks when v22 < this+0x3998; the pointer jumps by 918 dwords at the 8th element
sub_5895A2 converts v23 (v22 * 0.03125) to an integer index into the 8-byte-entry interpolation table at this+0x39A4; the fractional part v24 is retained for lerping two adjacent components

Per-patch capacity accumulation: the lerped-sum v27 is scaled by a gain selected from this+0x4*19+14796 (this+0x39CC) for patches up to 7 else from this+0x4820, and v40 = v27*gain / ((v21+144) * this+0x3514)
sub_5895A2 converts v28 (v38 * this+0x3CBC) into an index for the aerodynamic force table at this+0x3CC0; the index is clamped to [0,13] with lerp, or the first entry is used when negative
Final force: v17 = lerped_table_value * this+0x3518 * (sqrt(v48)/v35), then capped to the accumulated contact capacity v40 (v17 = min(v17, v40))
Returns v17 - this+0x3D44 * this+0x3518 * v37 - a4[2]; invoked from PhysicsNodePropagationWithDistanceFalloff (00401C90)

clean_pseudocode: if (fp_flags) v35 = lerp(table_pos, this[0x3C3C/4]*v38, base this[0x3C40/4]);
else        v35 = lerp(table_neg, this[0x3C7C/4]*v38, base this[0x3C80/4]);
